title: A World of Three Zeros — Visiting Yunus Centre & Grameen Bank
excerpt: Serving as Team Leader on a September 2024 study visit with 40 students, led by Dr. Farhana Ferdousi, Director, BBA & Associate Professor.
author: Fazley Rabbi
cover_alt: Group photograph during the September 2024 study visit.
body:
## Learning Beyond the Classroom

In September 2024, I joined a group of **40 students** for a study visit to **Yunus Centre and Grameen Bank**, led by **Dr. Farhana Ferdousi**, **Director, BBA & Associate Professor**.

The visit included the **A World of Three Zeros** workshop at Yunus Centre on **26 September 2024**, as recorded on my certificate of participation.

## My Role as Team Leader

As **Team Leader**, I coordinated student participation and supported the group throughout the visit. I collected participant information through forms, helped students with their questions and needs, and coordinated food arrangements. I also followed up on students’ journeys home to check that they had returned safely.

These responsibilities called for clear communication, careful organisation, and attention to the wellbeing of every participant.

## A World of Three Zeros

The exhibition introduced the vision of **zero poverty**, **zero unemployment**, and **zero net carbon emissions**. The photographs also document presentations, exhibition displays, and moments shared with fellow participants.

## A Record of the Visit

This gallery brings together the group photographs, learning spaces, displays, and participation certificate from the visit. It is a record of an opportunity to connect classroom learning with ideas about social business and its role in society.
